newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Two towns picked for Luxembourg informals.
newsitem.headline: Two towns picked for Luxembourg informals.

text.p: Luxembourg will hold its informal ministerial meetings in Mondorf and Echternach during its presidency of the European Union in the second half of this year, a government official said on Monday.

The "senior" councils of foreign and finance ministers will be held in Mondorf, to the east of Luxembourg city. The ECOFIN is set for September 12, 13 and 14. The foreign ministers will meet on October 25 and 26.
Other informals -- including justice and home affairs and agriculture -- will be held in Echternach, a medieval town to the north of the Grand Duchy.
